competences.description: Attacks the enemy to increase its chances of landing a Glancing Hit for 2 turns with a 50% chance.

effets.description: The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.

competences.description: Grants the Reflect Harmful Effect on the ally target for 2 turns, and the ally goes under the Threat state while the enemy attacks with a single-target skill 2 times. The target under Reflect Harmful Effect reflects harmful effects excluding inability effects.

effets.description: Reflects harmful effects granted on the Monster excluding inability effects.

The enemy can only attack the target under the Threat state when using the attack skill. The duration of the Threat will be reduced only by skills that attack a single enemy target. The target under the Threat state will be inflicted with 15% less damage when attacked.

competences.description: Calls out the Lord of Hell to fight for you, and it gains a turn instantly. The Lord of Hell has HP equal to 50% of your MAX HP and deals 50% increased damage. Once its HP becomes 0, it disappears and Devil Maiden reappears, gaining a turn instantly.

effets.note: Instantly when Lord of Hell's HP becomes 0
